content.text: Instructor Joseph Cataliotti Show bio Joe Cataliotti holds a Master of Arts degree in World History from Northeastern University. He earned a B.A. in History and Political Science from the same university and wrote his senior thesis on the history of radical right-wing movements in the United States. Cite this lesson Study West Francia, or the Kingdom of the West Franks. Learn about Charles the Bald's kingdom after the Treaty of Verdun and how West Francia became France.
